item.title: [ Mod ] Combine Soilders Voice for All Survivors
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 5
This mod replaces All of the L4D1 survivor voice lines and All of the L4D2 survivor voice lines with the Combine Metro Cops/Civil Protection and Overwatch Soldiers voices from Half-Life 2. WARNING: This mod uses SCRIPTS in order to share Bill's voice (HL2 Combine voice lines) with the other three survivors so they all share the same voice. May not work online.

item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 2
[ Español ] Campaña publicada en el año 2012 , el autor es Scythex [ Awarest ] , pertenece a una de las versiones antiguas de Big Wat que por suerte se pudo rescatar La campaña se puede terminar de principio a fin , por lo que podemos decir que el misterio de como eran Big Room y Wat Mania por fin han sido resueltos --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- [ Ingles ] Campaign published in 2012 by Scythex [ Awarest ] ; it belongs to one of the older versions of Big Wat that was fortunately recovered The campaign can be completed from start to finish, so we can say that the mystery of what Big Room and Wat Mania were like has finally been solved --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Creditos / Credits Awarest [ Autor ] Steam : https://steamcommunity.com/id/Awarets Gamemaps : https://www.gamemaps.com/profile/812127
